resources.string: Choose how long to simulate or stop. When the timer ends, the previous policy resumes using any automation updates received during the override. Force real cancels the timer and keeps simulation stopped.
Open MockGPS to check location permissions, mock location access and the selected location.
Android may delay expiry while asleep. Allow alarms and reminders in settings for precise timing.
Private storage is unavailable. Simulation remains stopped.
Allow automation to select this location
Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
The default credential can already submit readiness, stop and status commands. Preset selection also requires approval on each saved location.

Each integration with readiness permission must report Ready before automation can resume. Counters and revocation are separate for each credential. Creating or revoking one stops the current session and clears readiness.
Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters and select at least one permission.
Revoke this credential? The current session stops and all integrations must report fresh readiness. Other credentials remain valid.

Minutes from the first confirmed injection. Use 0 for unlimited, up to 1440. Changing this setting stops simulation and selects Keep stopped. Reaching the limit also selects Keep stopped, including during a temporary override.
Show notifications for errors and required actions

Use a toast for routine changes and one compact ongoing status notification. Android requires the foreground status and may show its own mock-location notice. In channel settings, choose Minimize if available to reduce status-bar icons.
Route imported. Enable playback, return to Auto and start a session when ready.
Could not read this route. Use UTF-8 GPX with one track segment or route, 2 to 2000 points, under 1 MiB, without DTDs or entities.

Play the imported route at a constant speed in km/h, with altitude and heading. Drift is disabled during playback. Each new session starts at the beginning. Completion selects Keep stopped. Enabling playback stops the current session; it does not start simulation.
